# thetalake_user_group (Resource)

The user group resource allows for the creation and management of user groups within Theta Lake.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "thetalake_user" "example" {
  email = "jane.smith@example.com"
}

resource "thetalake_user_group" "example" {
  name        = "Example User Group"
  description = "An example user group managed by Terraform"
  user_ids    = [data.thetalake_user.example.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the user group

### Optional

- `description` (String) The description of the user group
- `external_id` (String) An external ID for the user group
- `user_ids` (Set of Number) An array of user IDs to include in this user group

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The created timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
- `id` (Number) The user group ID
- `updated_at` (String) The updated timestamp using the RFC3339 date-time format
